rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Source URL + type label — mandatory.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 12: "Simon Willison, [Vibe engineering](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Oct/7/vibe-engineering/). He draws the line between vibe coding and working with coding agents as an accountable engineer." — a named-practitioner claim with a specific URL, but no source-type label appears anywhere in this file (body is correctly exempt per §1's maintainer-block scope, but the maintainer block's own Source-verification list — which stamps Horthy, Cherny, and the status-line delegation — has no entry for Willison at all). Harm: an unlabeled, unstamped citation is invisible to `source-freshness.sh` and to any future evidence-ladder audit; it can silently rot or get misquoted with no mechanism to catch it, exactly the harm §1/§11 exist to prevent, and that harm is present here (verified: no Willison entry in the maintainer block).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Add a Source-verification stamp line for the Willison URL (label: likely [practitioner direct], practitioner's own blog) alongside the existing Horthy/Cherny/Klaassen entries.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: OODA paraphrase ≠ primary source.
rules_evaluated.evidence: The Willison paraphrase ("draws the line between vibe coding and working with coding agents as an accountable engineer") reads as directly authored framing, not an OODA-subagent paraphrase artifact; no evidence of research-pipeline drift.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Freshness rule — 6 months.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Willison's "Vibe engineering" post is dated 2025-10-07 — over 10 months old as of the 2026-08-12 current date, past the 6-month window, and unlike the Cherny video (which carries an explicit maintainer-decision freshness exception recorded in the Meta block), Willison's citation has no such exception and no explicit historical dating in body. Harm: an undated, past-window citation reads as current framing rather than a dated historical account — the exact drift §2/§2a exist to prevent. Present here since the citation is unstamped (see rule 1) and therefore untracked by the freshness system entirely.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Either date it explicitly in body as a historical anchor, or add a maintainer-block freshness-exception note (Cherny-video pattern) explaining why the framing still holds.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Willison's post is a conceptual distinction/definition, not an account of a specific completed event, so the durable-account carve-out doesn't apply as a defense — this is the reason rule 2 above stays open rather than being closed by this carve-out.
